title: G-Safeguard: A Topology-Guided Security Lens and Treatment on LLM-based Multi-agent Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical detection and remediation of adversarial attacks (prompt injection, tool attacks, and memory poisoning) in multi-agent LLM systems. It treats 'misinformation' and 'harmful knowledge' as security vulnerabilities to be filtered or pruned rather than as a means to evaluate religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or specific ethical systems.
